The image shows a dried-out leaf with numerous small, dark, irregular spots and holes. This matches the symptom description for Anthracnose, which mentions "Spots start small, black, and irregular on leaves, expanding into large dead areas that dry and fall out." The other options do not fit as well: Die_Back describes upward rolling and browning of leaves, then twigs dying back; Sooty_Mould describes dark, superficial fungal deposits that turn the leaf surface black, but the leaf remains green underneath; and Gall_Midge describes wart-like galls.
